annotations.title: Register an intent with a verification probe (paid, x402)

description: PAID: dead-man switch for an irreversible action: register the intent, a lease and a probe; confirm in time or we run the probe and publish the verdict. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

description.description: What you are about to do.

leaseSeconds.description: How long before an unconfirmed entry's probe runs. 1..604800 seconds.

probe.description: At least one of expectedBodyContains / expectedStatus is required.

expectedBodyContains.description: The response body must contain this substring for the verdict to be confirmed-by-probe.

expectedStatus.description: The response status must equal this for the verdict to be confirmed-by-probe.

url.description: Absolute http:// or https:// URL, GETted from OUR vantage point once the lease expires.
